ability.jaycee.great_sage.desc: A Unique skill of supreme intellect. While owned it doubles chanting speed, accelerates thought and multiplies the mastery you earn tenfold.
ability.jaycee.great_sage.mode.analytica: Press to switch the scan on or off: whatever you look at within 15 blocks (25 mastered) is analysed on screen. Shift + press switches between creatures, blocks or both.
ability.jaycee.great_sage.mode.thought_a:
The world slows;
you move faster.
ability.jaycee.predator.desc: A Unique skill that devours anything: creatures, their skills and their EP, blocks and even fluids, all stored in its Stomach.
ability.jaycee.predator.mode.predation.d: Breathe out a devouring mist for 3 s: 10 damage per bite, draining 100 magicules and a skill. A kill devours all its skills and 30% of its EP. Shift + press: choose whether it eats blocks, fluids, both or neither. Cooldown 5 s (3 s mastered).
ability.jaycee.predator.mode.analysis.de: Opens the Stomach and refines what's inside while it stays open.
ability.jaycee.predator.mode.stomach.des: Opens the Stomach: 54 slots that only you can reach.
ability.jaycee.raphael.desc: The Lord of Wisdom, the Ultimate form of Great Sage. Thought Acceleration a millionfold, complete analysis, foresight of attacks, and every spell cast instantly with less mana.
ability.jaycee.magic_perception.desc: Press to sense magicules: living things nearby glow through walls, for you alone. Costs 5 magicules a second; mastered, it reaches twice as far.
ability.jaycee.self_regeneration.desc: On once learned. While hurt you regenerate 2 HP a second for 100 magicules every 5 seconds; mastered, 4 HP and 8 spiritual health a second. Learned by defeating 500 slimes. Evolves into Ultraspeed Regeneration.
ability.jaycee.flame_breath.desc: Hold to breathe a stream of fire: 8 damage a second (16 mastered) for 30 magicules a second.
ability.jaycee.body_armor.desc: Press to grow scale armor over every empty armor slot (5 / 10 / 8 / 5 armor, 4 toughness each). Press again with all four on to shed it. Shift + press grows a clawed gauntlet on your main hand (hits for 23, and you can block with it). Costs 50 magicules.
ability.jaycee.flame_attack_resistance.d: Reduces fire and heat damage. Learned by enduring flames; grows stronger with every hit.
ability.jaycee.flame_attack_nullificatio: Near-immunity to fire. A mastered Flame Attack Resistance becomes this at 1,000,000 EP.
ability.jaycee.fireball.desc: Hold to chant for 3 seconds (1 mastered), then release to hurl an exploding fireball: 100 magic + 30 fire damage in 3 blocks. Mastered, keep holding to the full 3 seconds for a charged one: 250 + 60 in 6 blocks. 30,000 magicules (50,000 charged).

race.jaycee.human.desc: A versatile and adaptable race with balanced development potential. Humans may seem ordinary, but they can grow beyond their limits through evolution, unique skills and special circumstances.
race.jaycee.human.strengths:
High adaptability and growth potential.
Balanced development across all areas.
Can evolve into higher existences (Enlightened, Saint).
race.jaycee.human.limitations:
Lower natural stats than monster races.
No innate resistances.
Relies on training, experience and skills.
race.jaycee.elf.desc: A long-lived people of the forest with a natural gift for magic and the bow. Elves see the flow of magicules more clearly than most.
race.jaycee.elf.strengths:
High magic control and mana.
Nimble and quick.
Natural talent for archery.
race.jaycee.elf.limitations:
Fragile body.
Weak physical strength.
Slow to recover from heavy wounds.
race.jaycee.dwarf.desc: Stout masters of stone and metal. Dwarves are hardy, stubborn and stronger than their size suggests.
race.jaycee.dwarf.strengths:
High strength and vitality.
Tough body.
Strong aura control.
race.jaycee.dwarf.limitations:
Slow movement.
Poor swimmers.
Limited magic talent.
race.jaycee.goblin.desc: Small, weak and quick to grow. A goblin that survives can become something far greater.
race.jaycee.goblin.strengths:
Fast early evolution.
Quick and agile.
Can branch into the Oni line.
race.jaycee.goblin.limitations:
Very weak at first.
Small body.
Low mana and aura.
race.jaycee.ogre.desc: Horned warriors of great strength. Ogres can awaken into Oni, mighty beings of spirit and battle.
race.jaycee.ogre.strengths:
Very high physical strength.
Strong aura.
Two Oni evolution paths.
race.jaycee.ogre.limitations:
Limited magic.
Large body is an easy target.
Evolving needs great power.
race.jaycee.orc.desc: Pig-headed brutes with endless hunger and endurance. In legend, an Orc Lord can grow into a disaster.
race.jaycee.orc.strengths:
High health and endurance.
Strong body.
Branching Orc Lord path.
race.jaycee.orc.limitations:
Slow and heavy.
Very low magic.
Feared and distrusted.
race.jaycee.lizardman.desc: Scaled warriors of the marshes with the blood of dragons in their veins. Their evolution leads toward the draconic.
race.jaycee.lizardman.strengths:
Tough scales and good swimming.
Born with Flame Breath.
Can evolve toward Divine Dragon.
race.jaycee.lizardman.limitations:
Weak to cold.
Average magic.
Dragon path needs great EP.
race.jaycee.halfling.desc: Small, cheerful and surprisingly lucky. Halflings are hard to notice and quick on their feet.
race.jaycee.halfling.strengths:
Agile and quick.
Good perception.
Balanced magic.
race.jaycee.halfling.limitations:
Small and weak body.
Low strength.
Limited reach.
race.jaycee.merfolk.desc: People of the sea with a fish tail. Merfolk rule the water but struggle on land until they evolve.
race.jaycee.merfolk.strengths:
Exceptional swimming and breathing underwater.
Good magic.
Strong in the sea.
race.jaycee.merfolk.limitations:
Slow on land with a tail.
Dries out on land too long.
Cannot grow legs at first.
race.jaycee.beastfolk.desc: Humanoids with the instincts of beasts. Beastfolk choose their animal path as they evolve: wolf, fox, cat, lion, rabbit or bird.
race.jaycee.beastfolk.strengths:
Fast and strong.
Keen senses.
Six beastkin branches.
race.jaycee.beastfolk.limitations:
Low magic.
Wild instincts.
Branch choice is permanent.
race.jaycee.slime.desc: The weakest of monsters, or so they say. A slime can absorb what it defeats and become something unimaginable.
race.jaycee.slime.strengths:
Very high magic potential.
No fall damage body.
Legendary evolution path.
race.jaycee.slime.limitations:
Extremely weak start.
No limbs or weapons.
Slow and small.
race.jaycee.giant.desc: Towering beings of raw strength. Giants grow ancient and, in time, divine.
race.jaycee.giant.strengths:
Huge health and strength.
Long reach.
High knockback resistance.
race.jaycee.giant.limitations:
Very slow.
Huge target.
Very low magic.
race.jaycee.insectoid.desc: A chitin-armoured insect being that thrives in swarms and evolves into the Soul and Divine Insect.
race.jaycee.insectoid.strengths:
Fast and agile.
Tough carapace.
Good perception.
race.jaycee.insectoid.limitations:
Weak to fire.
Low vitality.
Feared by most races.
race.jaycee.direwolf.desc: A wolf of the wild forest. Direwolves can become Tempest Wolves, wolves of storm and speed.
race.jaycee.direwolf.strengths:
Very fast.
Strong senses.
Pack instinct.
race.jaycee.direwolf.limitations:
Cannot use tools well.
Low magic.
Small health early.
race.jaycee.skeleton.desc: Bones bound by lingering magicules. Skeletons do not tire and can rise as Death Knights.
race.jaycee.skeleton.strengths:
No need to breathe.
Tireless.
Strong undead evolutions.
race.jaycee.skeleton.limitations:
Weak to holy power.
Fragile bones.
Healing is slow.
race.jaycee.zombie.desc: A corpse given hunger. Slow and tough, a zombie can become a Deathman and then a Death Spirit.
race.jaycee.zombie.strengths:
High health.
Hard to stop.
Poison resistant body.
race.jaycee.zombie.limitations:
Very slow.
Weak to holy power.
Low intelligence.
race.jaycee.ghoul.desc: A flesh-eating undead that can become a true Vampire if it gains enough power.
race.jaycee.ghoul.strengths:
Strong and fast.
Can become a Vampire.
Heals by feeding.
race.jaycee.ghoul.limitations:
Weak to sunlight and holy power.
Hated by the living.
Unstable body.
race.jaycee.wight.desc: An intelligent undead soul in armour. A Wight can rule as a Wight King.
race.jaycee.wight.strengths:
Good magic.
Command over lesser undead.
Strong spirit.
race.jaycee.wight.limitations:
Weak to holy power.
Fragile body.
Slow to heal.
race.jaycee.vampire.desc: An undying noble of the night. Vampires are powerful from the start but burn in the sun.
race.jaycee.vampire.strengths:
High stats across the board.
Strong regeneration at night.
Path to Divine Vampire.
race.jaycee.vampire.limitations:
Weak to sunlight.
Weak to holy power.
Hard to play early.
race.jaycee.lesser_daemon.desc: A spirit from the underworld bound to a body. Lesser Daemons rise toward Arch Daemon and Devil Lord.
race.jaycee.lesser_daemon.strengths:
High magic and aura.
Born with Flame Breath.
Path to Devil Lord.
race.jaycee.lesser_daemon.limitations:
Weak to holy power.
Unstable body.
Feared by most races.
race.jaycee.lesser_angel.desc: A spirit of light given form. Lesser Angels climb the heavenly ranks toward Seraph.
race.jaycee.lesser_angel.strengths:
Holy power.
Good magic and speed.
Path to Seraph.
race.jaycee.lesser_angel.limitations:
Weak to demonic power.
Fragile body.
Hard to grow early.
race.jaycee.elemental.desc: A living mass of elemental magicules. Elementals grow into Elemental Lords or Dryads of the forest.
race.jaycee.elemental.strengths:
Exceptional magic.
Weightless body.
Path to Dryad or Elemental Lord.
race.jaycee.elemental.limitations:
Very weak body.
Low strength.
Unstable without mana.
race.jaycee.phantom.desc: A shadow spirit that walks between life and death. Phantoms are swift, strong in spirit and hard to see.
race.jaycee.phantom.strengths:
High spirit, magic and aura.
Very fast.
Hard to detect.
race.jaycee.phantom.limitations:
Fragile body.
Weak to holy power.
Hard to play.
race.jaycee.pixie.desc: A tiny fairy spirit full of mischief and magic.
race.jaycee.pixie.strengths:
High magic.
Very quick.
Can fly as it grows.
race.jaycee.pixie.limitations:
Tiny and fragile.
Very low strength.
Easy to knock away.
jaycee.birthright.mortal_born.subtitle: An ordinary soul. Everything must be earned.
jaycee.birthright.mortal_born.chat: You were born Mortal. The Mist hides the hidden world from you, for now.
jaycee.birthright.oracle_born.subtitle: The Mist is thin around you.
jaycee.birthright.oracle_born.chat: You were born Oracle-born. You will see what others cannot, but it cannot touch you yet.
jaycee.birthright.godblood.subtitle: A god's blood runs in your veins.
jaycee.birthright.godblood.chat: You were born Godblood, the distant child of a god. The hidden world sees you, and it can reach you.

ability.jaycee.predator.mode.mimicry.des: Take the form of something you've devoured. Coming soon.
ability.jaycee.predator.mode.isolation.d: Empty hand: purge harmful effects from your target, or yourself, for 200 magicules each. Holding food: dissolve it into magicules and health.

ability.jaycee.infinite_regeneration.des: The peak of regeneration: body and spiritual health restored instantly. Learned with Ultraspeed Regeneration and over 2,000,000 EP.

ability.jaycee.coercion.desc: A roar that scares anything way weaker than you and weakens it. Shift + press (mastered) to change how much power you let out.
ability.jaycee.haki.desc: Hold to let your aura out. Everything in 15 blocks that is less than half as strong as you gets hit with Fear. You can barely move while doing it.
ability.jaycee.demon_lord_haki.desc: The demon lord version of Haki, much heavier. Coat mode wraps your attacks in haki so they hit harder.
ability.jaycee.hero_haki.desc: The holy version of Haki, golden and heavier than the normal one.
ability.jaycee.mortal_fear.desc: Your haki pours out of all your subordinates at once and powers them up. With no subordinates it just comes out of you.
ability.jaycee.strength.desc: Press for +6 attack damage for a minute (+12 for 2 minutes once mastered). Press again to drop it.
ability.jaycee.steel_strength.desc: Press for +12 attack damage for 30 seconds (+18 for 90 seconds once mastered).
ability.jaycee.strengthen_body.desc: Always on: +5 armor and you take 20% less damage.
ability.jaycee.thought_acceleration.desc: Always on: you think faster, so you move a bit faster and swing a lot faster.
ability.jaycee.paralysis.desc: While it is on your bar, your hits paralyze.
ability.jaycee.poison.desc: While it is on your bar, your hits poison.
ability.jaycee.corrosion.desc: While it is on your bar, your hits wither. Press it while holding raw meat to rot it.
ability.jaycee.ice_breath.desc: Hold to breathe ice. 8 damage a second (16 mastered) and it freezes.
ability.jaycee.thunder_breath.desc: Hold to breathe lightning. 10 damage a second (20 mastered).
ability.jaycee.poisonous_breath.desc: Hold to breathe poison. 15 damage a second (30 mastered).
ability.jaycee.paralysing_breath.desc: Hold to breathe a paralyzing gas. Paralysis III.
ability.jaycee.ultrasonic_waves.desc: A sonic blast in a line, 8 damage, leaves them dizzy.
ability.jaycee.voice_cannon.desc: Shout a blast in a line. 20 damage (30 mastered), 15 blocks (20 mastered).
ability.jaycee.water_blade.desc: Throw a slicing disc of water, 40 damage.
ability.jaycee.hydraulic_propulsion.desc: Shoot yourself forward. Only works in water or rain.
ability.jaycee.sense_heat_source.desc: Toggle: living things within 20 blocks glow for you.
ability.jaycee.universal_perception.desc: Magic Sense, heat and sound all in one. Everything within 30 blocks glows for you. 25 magicules a second.
jaycee.skill.scale.not_mastered: Master it first to hold your power back.
jaycee.skill.need_water: You need to be in water or rain.
ability.jaycee.shadow_motion.desc: Hold to melt into the shadows: invisible and fast. Only somewhere dark until you master it. Mastered, Step mode jumps you right behind whatever you look at.
ability.jaycee.ultra_instinct.desc: Toggle. Your body dodges on its own: 10% chance any hit just misses.
ability.jaycee.danger_sense.desc: Toggle. When something starts hunting you, you hear a bell from where it is.
ability.jaycee.snake_eye.desc: Hold to stare something down. It gets worse the longer you look. Modes: corrosion, poison, paralysis, petrification, insanity.
ability.jaycee.drain.desc: Bite something close for 6 damage and heal that much. No blood, no drain.
ability.jaycee.ogre_berserker.desc: Go berserk: +30 attack and +10 armor for 3 minutes (6 mastered). Costs 5,000 magicules.
ability.jaycee.scale_armor.desc: Always on: +6 armor and you swim faster.
ability.jaycee.dragon_skin.desc: Always on with no armor equipped: your skin works like armor, and gets tougher the more EP you have.
jaycee.skill.too_bright: Too bright here to hide in the shadows.
